name: HTML Block
author: Siddharth Nagar

sections.description:
Introduction

HTML block adds custom html blocks to WordPress. You can then add these blocks anywhere on your WordPress site using the shortcode provided.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Thats it! you can now configure the plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Fix: Shortcodes inside an HTML Block are now rendered, so blocks built with WPBakery / Visual Composer no longer output raw [vc_row][vc_column] tags.
  • Fix: WPBakery custom CSS and Design Options of an HTML Block are now loaded wherever the block is displayed.
  • Fix: Blocks created with the block editor (Gutenberg) are now rendered properly.
  • Fix: Prevented infinite loops when an HTML Block includes itself.

1.2

  • Security: The [html_block] shortcode now only renders published, non password-protected HTML Blocks. Previously the id attribute could be used to display the content of any post (including private, draft or password-protected posts) by users able to add shortcodes, e.g. Contributors.
  • Security: Sanitized shortcode attributes and escaped all admin output (shortcode column, plugin action links, admin JS variable).
  • Fix: Removed the broken uninstall hook that could cause a fatal error on PHP 8 when deleting the plugin.
  • Fix: Prevented a PHP error when the shortcode referenced a non-existent block ID.
  • Tweak: Added the text domain to all strings and removed the deprecated manual translation loading.
  • Tested OK with WordPress 7.1.

1.1

  • Tested OK with WordPress 6.4.1.

1.0

  • Initial release.
